ios.desc:
Your journal. Your planner. Your notes. Finally, one app that does it all.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Daily journal with rich timeline, mood tracking, and reflections
• Day planner with time blocking, Apple Calendar & Reminders sync
• Weekly and monthly views for planning ahead
• To-do lists with 5 stages: idea, to do, active, pending, finalized
• Habit tracker for building routines
• Goal tracker for fitness, health, and personal growth
• Notes and outlines for capturing ideas
• Collections for movies, books, recipes, and more
• Built-in Pomodoro timer
• Home screen widgets
• Works on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and web
• Syncs across all your devices
• End-to-end encryption
• Works offline
• No ads. Ever.

GETTING STARTED
• Watch the quick start videos in the app
• Pick one thing: journal, planner, or tasks
• Explore more when you're ready

TRY RISK-FREE
60-day money back guarantee. Not for you? Full refund, no questions asked.

ABOUT THE DEVELOPER
Hi, I'm Hai, the solo developer behind LiveIt. Since 2017, over a million people have used the app to organize their lives. I read every review and email — your feedback shapes what I build next.

CONNECT
• Support: hai@doit.me
• Reddit: r/liveitapp
• YouTube: youtube.com/@liveitapp
• Guide: liveit.me/guide

TERMS & PRIVACY
• Terms of Use (EULA): https://liveit.me/terms
• Privacy Policy: https://liveit.me/terms
